dedupe_keys.name: thermalnetwork ground heat exchanger network sizing

description: ThermalNetwork is a Python library from the National Laboratory of the Rockies for sizing multiple ground heat exchangers linked by a single-pipe thermal network. It has a command-line interface intended for URBANopt workflows and documentation for local use. Users provide building thermal loads, network topology, heat-exchanger options and design constraints; outputs are candidate equipment sizes and thermal-network performance estimates for the selected district. Geographic coverage is a user-defined neighbourhood or campus. BSD-3-Clause source, pip installation and public documentation are available. A limitation is that equipment sizing depends on subsurface properties, building demand and network layout; the package does not establish installation cost or permits by itself. ThermalNetwork can help compare district heating and cooling designs. The related catalogue EnergyPlus model supplies building energy simulation at another scale. No load series, site data or Python package was downloaded.
inputs: Building thermal loads, network topology and ground properties
name: ThermalNetwork ground heat-exchanger network sizing
